blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Moderate to heavy rain showers are expected to persist over some parts of Metro Manila and nearby provinces on Sunday, coinciding with All Saints’ Day, according to the state weather bureau. In a thunderstorm advisory issued at 1:50 p.m., the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said moderate to heavy rain showers with lightning and strong winds are expected over the following areas of Metro Manila within the next two hours: READ: Fair weather in Metro Manila, other parts of PH on All Saints’ Day Pagasa said this condition is also forecast over the following areas: […]...
